1981-2415-3899-8319.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3899-8319.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2026-3525-8328.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
2026-3525-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
2026-3525-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat from step 1

728-3240-6351-6462.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

874-2869-3184.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2869-3184.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by sacrificing it.
Yomiji triggers due to Leyline of Singularity, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Delif's Cone's ability.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Repeat.

4772-4826-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1462-2034-4679-7895.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear.
When the Little Bear token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Little Bear token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6968-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-6968-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6968-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

3276-5038-6797-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat as needed.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a mana producing land you control

2066-2092-4954.description:
Activate the land with Fertile Ground attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Fertile Ground triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2066-2092-4954.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

646-4691-7439.description:
Cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
When you lose life, Vilis triggers.
In response, activate Words of Worship by paying {1}, creating a replacement effect.
Resolve the Vilis trigger, causing you to gain 5 life instead of drawing a card due to the replacement effect.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Once you have gained an arbitrarily high amount of life, you may use Channel's ability any number of times, adding colorless mana and drawing cards with Vilis.
Once you have drawn your library, you will have {C} for each card drawn this way.
You can then continue to use Channel, adding infinite {C}, as long as you have drawn a way to remove Vilis or can use the mana to win at instant speed before Vilis's triggers resolve and cause you to lose by drawing from an empty library.

206-240-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

765-1558-2638-3129-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-2638-3129-4231.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3767-3918-3941-7223.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2511-7084-7201.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

321-399-2475-6707-7183.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

24-1640-5016.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Spitemare instead of you due to Pariah's Shield if you chose the largest number.
Spitemare triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-1640-5016.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

1495-2942-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting three +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Fiery Emancipation.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2595-5641-5662.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to Combine Guildmage.
When Basking Broodscale enters, it triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Combine Guildmage.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-3000-4593-5789.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3000-4593-5789.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

5296-5365-5929-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}
Repeat.
5296-5365-5929-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Workhorse for additional mana.

2558-3698-4186-6701.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
2558-3698-4186-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-3921-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Winding Constrictor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3693-3921-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

2440-3464-4183-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Hyrax Tower Scout
2440-3464-4183-5115.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout with haste.
When the token Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Hyrax Tower Scout trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Hyrax Tower Scout, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Hyrax Tower Scout for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Gemstone Array twice by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

997-2792-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
997-2792-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Great Whale, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2034-3490-3545.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2034-3490-3545.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sigil Captain triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-745.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Mirrorhall Mimic.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Mirrorhall Mimic and another permanent you control.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

147-1223-2438.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
147-1223-2438.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities, putting that many +1/+1 counters on it.

1283-2034-2660-2986-3139.description:
Cast Growth-Chamber Guardian by paying {1}{G}.
Growth-Chamber Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering The Great Henge, putting a +1/+1 counter on Growth-Chamber Guardian and drawing you a card.
Growth-Chamber Guardian triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Growth-Chamber Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
Growth-Chamber Guardian is put on the bottom of your library from the battlefield due to Wheel of Sun and Moon's effect.
Resolve the Growth-Chamber Guardian trigger from step 3, searching your library for Growth-Chamber Guardian and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.

495-637-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nested Shambler, adding {B}.
Mortuary, Nested Shambler and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Nested Shambler on top of your library.
Resolve the Nested Shambler trigger, creating a number of tapped 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens equal to Nested Shambler's power.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Nested Shambler from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Cast Nested Shambler by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1800-2011.notablePrerequisites: You control creatures that can deal at least six combat damage that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1800-2011.description:
Attack with the creatures to deal at least six combat damage to a player, triggering Old Gnawbone's ability, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Before the end of your combat phase, activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, to add {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} to untap all creatures you control, give them trample, lifelink, and haste and to get an additional combat phase and an additional main phase after that.
End the combat phase.
Repeat.

1367-3039-3502-4243.notablePrerequisites:
Yennett does not have summoning sickness.
Liliana has at least three loyalty counters.
Opponents are unable to kill Yennett.
1367-3039-3502-4243.description:
Activate Liliana's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Nexus of Fate, shuffling your library and putting Nexus of Fate on top of your library.
Activate Venser's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, exiling Liliana until your end step.
Proceed to your combat phase, and declare Yennett as an attacker.
Yennett triggers, revealing Nexus of Fate from the top of your library and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, getting an extra turn after this one and shuffling it into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Liliana returns from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

38-659-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Krenko.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
38-659-2178.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of Goblin tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prosperctor by sacrificing a Goblin you control, adding {R}.
Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.
